question: Do you remember Ohiru Rider, from the SBS in One Piece Volume 29, p. 148? Today I'm introducing his friend. It's "Asa Pierrot"-kun! He is Buggy's master, and is friends with Ohiru Rider. (Note: Ohiru means noon, and is represented by the kanji 昼. Asa means morning, and is represented by the kanji 朝. In both cases, the kanji is transformed into a face as shown here and in SBS Volume 29.)
answer: Wow. That's interesting, "Asa Pierrot". After the volume in which I drew "Ohiru Rider", many readers start drawing it in the margins of fan letters (*laugh*). So this time I'll add one more person, allow me to introduce "Tsurumihamarumarumushi-jiisan"! Here he is → (Note: Tsurumihamarumarumushi is spelled つる三八〇〇ムシ. The symbols all combine together to make the face in the picture.)
